en: 14 miles upstream, a lake sat|behind a wall of packed earth.

14 miles upstream, a lake sat
behind a wall of packed earth.

en: Cut it open, and you see the problem:
text: Cut it open, and you see the problem:

en: 60 feet of water, held back by dirt.

en: At about 3:10 p.m.,|the dam gave way.

At about 3:10 p.m.,
the dam gave way.

en: 20 million tons of water|poured down the valley,
text:
20 million tons of water
poured down the valley,

en: a wave 35 feet high at its crest.
text: a wave 35 feet high at its crest.

en: At the Stone Bridge, the wreckage|piled 40 feet high, and caught fire.

At the Stone Bridge, the wreckage
piled 40 feet high, and caught fire.
